mapper.insert: INSERT INTO index_task(task_id,kind,tenant_id,user_id,source_id,desired_version, completed_version,status,attempts,next_attempt_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{id},#{kind},#{tenant},#{user},#{source},1,0,'PENDING',0,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE desired_version=desired_version+1, status=CASE WHEN lease_owner IS NULL THEN 'PENDING' ELSE status END, attempts=0, next_attempt_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_error=NULL, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.sql: kind IN ('KNOWLEDGE','FILE','MEMORY') AND ( (status IN ('PENDING','RETRY') AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) OR (status='RUNNING' AND lease_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM index_task WHERE ORDER BY next_attempt_at LIMIT #{limit}

mapper.update: UPDATE index_task SET status='RUNNING',lease_owner=#{owner},lease_until=#{deadline},attempts=attempts+1, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id=#{task.id} AND desired_version=#{task.version} AND ((status IN ('PENDING','RETRY') AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) OR (status='RUNNING' AND lease_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
UPDATE index_task SET lease_until=#{deadline} WHERE task_id=#{task.id} AND lease_owner=#{task.owner} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_until >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE index_task SET status=CASE WHEN desired_version=#{task.version} THEN #{state} ELSE 'PENDING' END, completed_version=CASE WHEN #{state}='SUCCEEDED' THEN #{task.version} ELSE completed_version END, attempts=CASE WHEN desired_version=#{task.version} THEN #{attempts} ELSE 0 END, next_attempt_at=CASE WHEN desired_version=#{task.version} THEN #{nextAttempt} ELSE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP END, last_error=CASE WHEN desired_version=#{task.version} THEN #{error} ELSE NULL END, lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id=#{task.id} AND lease_owner=#{task.owner} AND lease_until >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM index_task WHERE task_id=#{task.id} AND status='FAILED' AND desired_version=#{task.version}
mapper.update: UPDATE index_task SET status='PENDING',attempts=0,next_attempt_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE task_id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenant} AND user_id=#{user} AND status='FAILED'
